#1 Damage: 545% ATK

bio: You wouldn't think a girl with bubblegum hair, riding a bear made of slime, would be Shadespire's most notorious bouncer. Nor would you think that this duo are key players in Shadespire's criminal underworld, yet Roxxi & Gumm are both. Roxxi rose to power by creating Gumm from a nigh-indestructible goo of her own design. Now everyone wants a taste - but power doesn't come cheap.
